description: Real-cell world frame defined from the fixed overhead camera (2026-11-17). z up = floor normal fitted to the overhead depth; y = the image x axis (left to right) projected on the floor; x = y cross z (toward the camera). Origin chosen so the twin layout (bases at x = -/+0.42, y = -1.065, facing +y; person at +y) fits the open floor in view. All vectors are in the overhead colour camera frame nuc/rgb_camera_link (OpenCV optical axes), metres. Origin moved 0.25 m along +y at 23:47 for clearance from the barrier posts.
source: one frame at 23:36, stock NUC (1080P, NFOV_2X2BINNED, 5 fps); plane fit 10749 pts, residual sd 6.1 mm
